learning_objective.statement: Apply the store-and-forward process to determine how an intermediate node handles a complete packet.

experience.title: You're the Router
experience.scenario: A packet arrives at an intermediate node while traveling from its source toward its destination. The packet is not yet at the destination.
experience.challenge: You are responsible for handling the packet at this intermediate node. Decide what happens next.
experience.learner_action: Choose the action sequence that correctly applies store-and-forward.

feedback.correct: Correct. The node receives the complete packet, stores it, and then forwards it toward the destination.
feedback.explanation: The source describes store-and-forward as receiving a complete packet, storing it, and then forwarding it.

assessment.question: A complete packet has arrived at an intermediate node. What should happen next in a store-and-forward network?

options.text: Store the packet first, then receive the rest of it.
Receive the complete packet, store it, then forward it.
Immediately create a direct physical link to the destination.
Discard the packet because it has reached an intermediate node.

mastery_evidence.mastery_signal: correctly applies the receive-store-forward sequence to an intermediate node
